## BlackRock Discloses $18.6B Position in Analog Devices; Oaktop Adds $185M

BlackRock's figure reflects index-level ownership rather than active conviction; the more actionable read is Oaktop's discretionary position alongside the upward pre-earnings revisions in the ADI earnings cluster — together these suggest building institutional interest heading into ADI's report.

- BlackRock disclosed a new $18.61B position in ADI and Oaktop Capital disclosed a new $185.16M position, per headline figures.
- Both are 13F filings and reflect holdings as of the reporting date, not necessarily current or discretionary purchases.
- BlackRock's position size is consistent with its role as a large passive and index manager rather than an active conviction buyer.
- Cluster appears alongside multiple other ADI institutional disclosure stories in this digest cycle.
